Package dev.walshy.sfmetrics.charts

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AddonsChart
    This AdvancedPie shows us what Addons are installed on the Server.
    AutoUpdaterChart
    This SimplePie shows us how many Servers have enabled or disabled automatic updates.
    AverageTimingsChart  
    CommandChart
    This AdvancedPie shows us what SubCommand of Slimefun is run very often.
    CompatibilityModeChart
    This SimplePie shows us how many Servers have enabled or disabled backwards-compatibility.
    CSCoreLibChart  
    DisabledItemsChart
    This AdvancedPie shows us what Items have been disabled on the Server.
    ErrorReportsChart
    This single line graph shows the amount of ErrorReports generated.
    IntegrationsChart
    This AdvancedPie shows us which Plugins the current Slimefun installation has integrated with.
    MetricsAutoUpdatesChart
    This SimplePie shows us whether a Server has enabled or disabled automatic updates for our MetricsModule.
    MetricsVersionChart
    This SimplePie shows us the currently installed version of this MetricsModule.
    NewServersChart
    This single line graph shows the amount of Servers that installed Slimefun for the very first time.
    OnlinePlayersChart
    This SimplePie allows us to see how big a Server is (player-wise).
    PlayerLanguageChart
    This AdvancedPie allows us to see what Languages are selected by Players.
    ResearchesEnabledChart
    This SimplePie allows us to see how many Servers have enabled or disabled Researches.
    ResourcePackChart
    This SimplePie allows us to see what Slimefun Resource pack version is installed on Servers or whether they set up their resource packs.
    ServerLanguageChart
    This SimplePie allows us to see what Servers have configured as their default Language.
    SlimefunVersionChart
    This DrilldownPie allows us to see what version of Slimefun is installed on Servers.
    TickRateChart
    This DrilldownPie shows us the configured tick rate.
